\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 177-180 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:AR-R185-first-pass-words-from-chapters-177-180}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a bull and an insect.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item expensive, free, raw, cooked, fried
  \item official, private, in a hurry, clear, hard-working
  \item grey, golden, thick, humid, rainy
  \item injured, rural, traditional, foreign, flat
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Expensive? (\textbf{\ar{مكلف}}, \emph{mukallif}.) Free? (\textbf{\ar{مجاني}}, \emph{majjānī}.) Raw? (\textbf{\ar{نيء}}, \emph{nayʾ}.) Cooked? (\textbf{\ar{مطبوخ}}, \emph{maṭbūkh}.) Fried? (\textbf{\ar{مقلي}}, \emph{maqlī}.) Official? (\textbf{\ar{رسمي}}, \emph{rasmī}.) Private? (\textbf{\ar{خاص}}, \emph{khāṣṣ}.) In a hurry? (\textbf{\ar{مستعجل}}, \emph{mustaʿjil}.) Clear? (\textbf{\ar{واضح}}, \emph{wāḍiḥ}.) Hard-working? (\textbf{\ar{مجتهد}}, \emph{mujtahid}.) Grey? (\textbf{\ar{رمادي}}, \emph{ramādī}.) Golden? (\textbf{\ar{ذهبي}}, \emph{dhahabī}.) Thick? (\textbf{\ar{سميك}}, \emph{samīk}.) Humid? (\textbf{\ar{رطب}}, \emph{raṭb}.) Rainy? (\textbf{\ar{ممطر}}, \emph{mumṭir}.) Injured? (\textbf{\ar{مصاب}}, \emph{muṣāb}.) Rural? (\textbf{\ar{ريفي}}, \emph{rīfī}.) Traditional? (\textbf{\ar{تقليدي}}, \emph{taqlīdī}.) Foreign? (\textbf{\ar{أجنبي}}, \emph{ajnabī}.) Flat? (\textbf{\ar{مسطح}}, \emph{musaṭṭaḥ}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 181-185 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:AR-R185-second-pass-words-from-chapters-181-185}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a washing machine and an air conditioner.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a washing machine, an air conditioner, a tin, a sink, a shelf
  \item a sauce, a sandwich, ice cream, a meal, a skirt
  \item a postage stamp, a parcel, a cheque, a form, a document
  \item a festival, an invitation, an occasion, decorations, a film
  \item a dolphin, a parrot, an ant, a bull, an insect
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A washing machine? (\textbf{\ar{غسالة}}, \emph{ghassāla}.) An air conditioner? (\textbf{\ar{مكيف}}, \emph{mukayyif}.) A tin? (\textbf{\ar{علبة}}, \emph{ʿulba}.) A sink? (\textbf{\ar{مغسلة}}, \emph{maghsala}.) A shelf? (\textbf{\ar{رف}}, \emph{raff}.) A sauce? (\textbf{\ar{صلصة}}, \emph{ṣalṣa}.) A sandwich? (\textbf{\ar{شطيرة}}, \emph{shaṭīra}.) Ice cream? (\textbf{\ar{مثلجات}}, \emph{muthallajāt}.) A meal? (\textbf{\ar{وجبة}}, \emph{wajba}.) A skirt? (\textbf{\ar{تنورة}}, \emph{tannūra}.) A postage stamp? (\textbf{\ar{طابع}}, \emph{ṭābiʿ}.) A parcel? (\textbf{\ar{طرد}}, \emph{ṭard}.) A cheque? (\textbf{\ar{شيك}}, \emph{shīk}.) A form? (\textbf{\ar{استمارة}}, \emph{istimāra}.) A document? (\textbf{\ar{وثيقة}}, \emph{wathīqa}.) A festival? (\textbf{\ar{مهرجان}}, \emph{mahrajān}.) An invitation? (\textbf{\ar{دعوة}}, \emph{daʿwa}.) An occasion? (\textbf{\ar{مناسبة}}, \emph{munāsaba}.) Decorations? (\textbf{\ar{زينة}}, \emph{zīna}.) A film? (\textbf{\ar{فيلم}}, \emph{fīlm}.) A dolphin? (\textbf{\ar{دلفين}}, \emph{dulfīn}.) A parrot? (\textbf{\ar{ببغاء}}, \emph{babbaghāʾ}.) An ant? (\textbf{\ar{نملة}}, \emph{namla}.) A bull? (\textbf{\ar{ثور}}, \emph{thawr}.) An insect? (\textbf{\ar{حشرة}}, \emph{ḥashara}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
